Core lore domains: hidden breath, unseen sovereignty, veiled sun power, and secret paths. Ascension means restored and expanding divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not transform a mortal into divinity. Backstory alignment: Amunet, Hidden Breath Goddess, is one of the four playable gods/goddesses of Aten Ra in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Visual description to preserve exactly in spirit: Amunet manifests as hidden wind and unseen name goddess, concealed solar breath, secret execution from Aten Ra: alluring feminine hidden-sun face, narrow luminous eyes, delicate nose, knowing half-smile behind translucent veil; beautiful slender feminine dancer-assassin frame, narrow shoulders, lithe hips, silent coiled posture without muscular bulk; signature silhouette: veiled obsidian crown, trailing shadow ribbons, twin low blades, almost-vanishing profile. Weapon: paired obsidian name-knives with electrum-gold hilts, carried in veiled hands. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic. Faction visual thesis: Aten Ra is the source behind human Egyptian solar myth: living Ma’at, Ra’s noon authority, Aten’s sun-disc radiance, Khepri’s renewal, Iset’s throne-magic, Sutekh’s necessary desert violence, Maahes’ lion protection, and Amunet’s hidden power.
